name: Goblin Minion

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

description: Goblin minions are the least experienced fighters of a goblin warband, thrown into the fray in numbers to wear down foes before the warriors and boss close in.
